items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge (Dot, due Sun 28 Feb, 16 days late); Clear the drainage ditch (Hal, due Mon 1 Mar, 15 days late); Return the borrowed rotavator (Josef, due Wed 10 Mar, 6 days late); Renew the public liability insurance (Tomas, due Sun 14 Mar, 2 days late).

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through), and send round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes — “Fix the main gate lock” (Wren, due Mon 22 Mar) is waiting on the Council (Estates Team), and “Get the water meter replaced” (Hal, due Thu 25 Mar) is waiting on the council; the visit has not been booked yet.

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
Has the number of manure loads been decided? If so, how many?
items.answer: No — the “Order manure” task says “how many loads? ask at the meeting”.
Josef is strimming the top half; Dot is strimming the bottom half.
